title: Divide Array Into Increasing Sequences
description: Given an integer array `nums` sorted in non-decreasing order and an integer `k`, return `true`* if this array can be divided into one or more disjoint increasing subsequences of length at least *`k`*, or *`false`* otherwise*.

examples.explanation: The array can be divided into two subsequences [1,2,3,4] and [2,3,4] with lengths at least 3 each.
There is no way to divide the array using the conditions required.

constraints: nums is sorted in non-decreasing order.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Divide Array Into Increasing Sequences.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
